title: Ask Elias about Hep

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Who are you?

nodes.speaker: Elias Malt
nodes.text: Do you know how often I hear these words?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Do you know how often I hear these words?

nodes.speaker: Elias Malt
nodes.text: You're asking too much. Now where did you hear that name?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You're asking too much. Now where did you hear that name?

nodes.speaker: Elias Malt
nodes.text: Then you've met a hero. Agent Gimble was a CorpSec Erasure Technician. One of the best. Her record remains unbeaten to this day.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Then you've met a hero. Agent Gimble was a CorpSec Erasure Technician. One of the best. Her record remains unbeaten to this day.
She removed people. From existence.

nodes.speaker: Elias Malt
nodes.text: No, an Erasure Technician. You know, there is still a saying in Lowtown. "Gone to Gimble." It means something has vanished without a trace. That's how good she was.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: No, an Erasure Technician. You know, there is still a saying in Lowtown. "Gone to Gimble." It means something has vanished without a trace. That's how good she was.

nodes.speaker: Elias Malt
nodes.text: Loyalty, of course. And she was wise, too. Though there still are people who would like to get hold of her brain to see what's left.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Loyalty, of course. And she was wise, too. Though there still are people who would like to get hold of her brain to see what's left.

nodes.speaker: Elias Malt
nodes.text: Agent Gimble gimbled her own mind out of existence when she retired. There's nothing left.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Agent Gimble gimbled her own mind out of existence when she retired. There's nothing left.
Ah, a smartass! Bugger off!
Then ask away.

nodes.speaker: Elias Malt
nodes.text: Hmm. This is no game, Fuck off.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Hmm. This is no game, Fuck off.

nodes.speaker: Elias Malt
nodes.text: I'm not surprised. She's a hero to many. One of the best CorpSec Erasure Technicans in the bureau. Her record remains unbeaten to this day.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm not surprised. She's a hero to many. One of the best CorpSec Erasure Technicans in the bureau. Her record remains unbeaten to this day.
How interesting you think so.

nodes.speaker: Elias Malt
nodes.text: She could link CorpSec to certain... high profile crimes. Cause them some embarrassment.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: She could link CorpSec to certain... high profile crimes. Cause them some embarrassment.

nodes.speaker: Elias Malt
nodes.text: Dissidents. Trouble makers. People who want proof that CorpSec ordered certain... tragic fatalities.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Dissidents. Trouble makers. People who want proof that CorpSec ordered certain... tragic fatalities.

nodes.speaker: Elias Malt
nodes.text: Whatever it took to get the information.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Whatever it took to get the information.

nodes.speaker: Elias Malt
nodes.text: I assume so. Those of an... anarchist disposition. That old brigand Huckstash, for example. He would be the type.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I assume so. Those of an... anarchist disposition. That old brigand Huckstash, for example. He would be the type.

nodes.speaker: Elias Malt
nodes.text: Then you better tell me where she is. To ensure her safety.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Then you better tell me where she is. To ensure her safety.

nodes.speaker: Elias Malt
nodes.text: You asked. Perhaps you should tell me where she is, for her safety.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You asked. Perhaps you should tell me where she is, for her safety.

nodes.speaker: Elias Malt
nodes.text: I see. Well, CorpSec thanks you for your service.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I see. Well, CorpSec thanks you for your service.

nodes.speaker: Elias Malt
nodes.text: I see. Well, you have your information. Don't forget that favor.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I see. Well, you have your information. Don't forget that favor.
I met someone interesting recently.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Have you ever heard of Hepzibah Gimble?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Have you ever heard of Hepzibah Gimble?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Have you ever heard of Hepzibah Gimble?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Have you ever heard of Hepzibah Gimble?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I met her.
"Erasure Technician?"
She was an assassin?
Why would she do that?
So what happened to her?
I'm nobody.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: But in this case it's true!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: But in this case it's true!
pronounText.TextSheVersion: But in this case it's true!
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: But in this case it's true!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Three times a week?
Just heard it around.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Sometimes a little discreet killing is necessary.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Sometimes a little discreet killing is necessary.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Sometimes a little discreet killing is necessary.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Sometimes a little discreet killing is necessary.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Why?
What people?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: So there are people who would pay to know her location...?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: So there are people who would pay to know her location...?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: So there are people who would pay to know her location...?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: So there are people who would pay to know her location...?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What would these "dissidents" do to her?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What would these "dissidents" do to her?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: What would these "dissidents" do to her?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: What would these "dissidents" do to her?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: She's just an old woman. She doesn't remember anything.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: She's just an old woman. She doesn't remember anything.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: She's just an old woman. She doesn't remember anything.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: She's just an old woman. She doesn't remember anything.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Why are you telling me?
She's in Skyhigh Gardens.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Think I'll keep that to myself.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Think I'll keep that to myself.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Think I'll keep that to myself.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Think I'll keep that to myself.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: All the time?
Fine.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You're even giving me a location?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You're even giving me a location?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: You're even giving me a location?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: You're even giving me a location?
